There's nothing like squats... I mean, nothing compares to squats. You can do leg press... But why? Why do an inferior movement? Why do a movement that looks showy, but produces hardly any results?
YOU HAVE TO ACHIEVE FAILURE! YOU HAVE TO TAKE IT THAT FAR! NOBODY WANTS TO GO THAT FAR, IT'S TOO SCARY. BUT YOU KNOW SOMETHING? I GOT NEWS FOR YOU, THAT'S WHERE WINNING IS!!
